_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. Declared --slate-* names (plus the Tailwind theme vars in the same bundle and the legacy --f_t_* ramp) cover the scales under core.* and the semantic roles under light.color.* — the only theme the signed-out site paints. The .fs-mode-on-surface scope lands under light.color.onSurface.*. Measured computed styles cover the typography composites and core.component.* geometry. Vendor vars (toastify, OneTrust) are deliberately not tokenised.

sans.description: The Graphik_fix sans stack the UI type ramp uses.

serif.description: The Nantes_fix serif stack the display roles use.
